benchmark.warmup_rule: 2 fixed warmup runs per backend/prompt case; excluded from timed metrics.
benchmark.aggregation_rule: Median over timed runs with mean/stdev/min/max/p05/p95 retained.
benchmark.first_run_policy: All timed trials are preserved for explicit first-run inspection.
benchmark.compile_policy: MLXs eager primary canonical case; compiled MLXs separately labeled secondary variant.
benchmark.stream_policy: Dedicated generation stream is explicit on both canonical paths.
benchmark.cache_policy: Prefill clears cache per chunk; decode uses parameter 256 with backend-specific runtime semantics recorded explicitly.

prefill.start: Immediately before the first runtime call that consumes shared prompt token ids.
prefill.end: Prompt ingestion complete and first-step logits or seed state ready, before first token availability.

ttft.end: First generated token id becomes available to the harness after required eval/materialization.

decode.end: Last-token availability for the fixed max-token target.

end_to_end.role: Secondary summary metric only for Class A.

fairness_contract.same_model_policy: Both sides load the same fixed model artifact for canonical sign-off.
fairness_contract.same_weight_format_policy: Weight-format class is recorded per row and must match for fair comparison.
fairness_contract.same_tokenization_policy: Shared prompt token ids are built once outside the timed region and passed unchanged to both backends.

mlx_lm.stream_handling: Dedicated generation stream from mlx-lm upstream path.
mlx_lm.mx_async_eval: Used during decode for current and next token buffers.
mlx_lm.mx_eval: Explicit mx.eval(y) for the first generated token.
mlx_lm.item_extraction: Yield path uses y.item() per generated token.
mlx_lm.clear_cache_decode_rule: Loop index % 256 == 0 after each yielded token (includes the first yielded token).

mlxs_eager.runtime_path_label: benchmark-local helper on the canonical Layer 1 subtree
mlxs_eager.stream_handling: Dedicated benchmark-owned generation stream via CoreExecutionPolicy.
mlxs_eager.mx_async_eval: Not used on the current Layer 1 path; deliberate documented divergence.
mlxs_eager.mx_eval: mx.eval(token) before scalar extraction; cache state eval during chunked prefill.
